messages:
jia: Heads-up: master CI is red after the dependency bump to libfoo 2.4. Failing in the integration matrix job (linux-x86, gpu). Can someone help bisect or coordinate a revert?

devops-bot: [JOB 7821] build failed: https://ci.redwood.dev/7821 logs: /artifacts/7821/failed.log :rotating_light:

priya: thanks for flagging — do we know the last-good commit?

jia: last-green sha: 4b2f6a7 (passed at 1898762000). First red at 1898765300.

eric: failing test is TestKVCacheEviction::test_basic_eviction. Log excerpt:
```
thread 'tokio-runtime' panicked at 'assertion failed: cache.len() == 0', tests/kv_cache.rs:143
stack backtrace...
```

marco: rough guess: the libfoo 2.4 change touched allocator behavior. Could be a subtle ordering regression. Worth bisecting commits between 4b2f6a7..HEAD or reverting the lib bump if we need a fast rollback.

priya: prefer a short revert if it's trivial — we can unblock customers faster. Who can open a quick revert PR and cut a patch release?

eric: I can run the bisect first (should take ~30m) and confirm culprit. If it's clearly libfoo we can revert. Command I'll run: `scripts/ci/bisect --range=4b2f6a7..HEAD --test=TestKVCacheEviction::test_basic_eviction --matrix=linux-x86,gpu`

jia: thanks. If bisect narrows to one commit, please @me and I'll draft the revert PR. If it's multiple, we'll triage.

ci-bot: bisect job queued (id=8923). Will post updates.

ci-bot: bisect update: candidate 12/24 checked — failing at 4f7b9c2, passing at 3d9a1b0. Narrowing...

eric: bisect found suspect: commit 4f7b9c2 — bump libfoo to 2.4. Patch touches allocator.rs and shmem helpers. Reproduced locally: tests fail on GPU target too.

marco: ok that's pretty definitive. Priya, want me to open the revert PR (revert 4f7b9c2) and tag eng-platform + eng-infra for express review?

priya: please do. Add a short description referencing CI job 7821 and bisect results. I'll expedite review and merge once CI green on the revert branch.

jia: also add a note to the changelog entry so we don't reintroduce the bump accidentally.

eric: created revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/4102 — includes test-only patch to ensure eviction deterministic behavior. Kicked CI on PR.

devops-bot: [PR 4102] build started: https://ci.redwood.dev/pr/4102 :building_construction:

priya: nice. I'll review now. If CI on PR passes, merge + backport to the active release branch.

ci-bot: PR 4102 CI: all checks passed.

priya: merged, backport queued to release/v1.2. Patch release requested.

marco: thanks everybody. Post-merge action: I'll follow up with a brief postmortem note (root cause & plan: fix allocator ordering in libfoo or add a guard) and assign follow-up to eng-ml to validate with larger seq lengths.

jia: great. Marking this triaged — re-open if flakes reappear. :thumbsup:
